title: DataComp-LM: In search of the next generation of training sets for language models
data_curation: DCLM-POOL is a 240T-token (GPT-NeoX) raw web-text corpus from all Common Crawl before 2023 (200B documents, 370TB gzipped), re-extracted with resiliparse rather than Common Crawl WET files (resiliparse/trafilatura beat WET by ~2.5 CORE points at 1B-1x, and resiliparse is 8x faster). DCLM-BASELINE (3.8T tokens) is built by: resiliparse extraction -> RefinedWeb heuristic filters (English, page-length, repetition, word-removal-ratio, URL) -> Bloom-filter near-duplicate dedup (comparable to MinHash but scales past 10TB) -> fastText model-based quality filter keeping the top-10%. The fastText classifier is trained on ~400k documents with positives from OpenHermes-2.5 (OH-2.5) + r/ExplainLikeImFive (ELI5) and negatives from a RefinedWeb reproduction; this OH-2.5+ELI5 choice gives +3.5 CORE points over Wikipedia/OpenWebText2/GPT-3-style positives. Mixing Wikipedia/Books/StackExchange/arXiv/GitHub (Llama1/RPJ ratios) helps weak CC subsets but hurts DCLM-BASELINE. Decontamination tooling is released; removing MMLU/Hellaswag overlaps does not lower scores. 416 baseline experiments span five scales (400M-1x to 7B-2x).
curriculum: Not the central focus, but a fixed pretraining recipe isolates data effects, and a staged recipe is used for the flagship 7B. Scales use Chinchilla-optimal token counts (20 x params x multiplier). The 2.5T flagship run is two-stage: stage-1 pretrain 2T tokens on DCLM-BASELINE + StarCoder + ProofPile2, then cooldown on a reweighted mix (70% DCLM-BASELINE with a tighter fastText top-7% threshold + 30% ProofPile). Two independent cooldowns (200B and 270B tokens) are averaged via a model soup (0.8/0.2 weights). Continual pretraining (~120B tokens, Grow-Linear variable-length curriculum, RoPE base 10k->100k) extends context 2048->8192. Instruction tuning uses OH-2.5 or the custom 4M-instance/8B-token DCLM-IT mix (UltraFeedback, Tulu-v2 SFT, CodeFeedback, Nectar, NoRobots, WildChat, WebInstruct, StarCoder2-Self-OSS-Instruct) with Adam, 10 epochs, cosine LR; no PPO/DPO alignment is applied.
method: The core contribution is a data-centric benchmark/testbed plus the empirical finding that model-based quality filtering dominates other curation choices. Across seven filters compared at 1B-1x -- PageRank, SemDedup, BGE-embedding linear classifier, AskLLM, CCNet-style perplexity (154M causal LM trained on Wikipedia+RedPajama-books+peS2o), top-k average logits, and fastText -- a simple fastText bigram classifier wins (CORE 30.2 vs 27.5 RefinedWeb reproduction). Filtering-model details swing 7B/280B MMLU from 35% to 44%. Models are standard decoder-only Transformers (GPT-2/Llama-style) trained with next-token prediction + z-loss, LayerNorm-without-bias, qk-LayerNorm, SwiGLU, depth-scaled init, in OpenLM/FSDP at 2048 context. Flagship tricks include cooldown-distribution reweighting, model souping of two cooldowns, and continual long-context adaptation. There is no novel RL/preference algorithm; the method is curation-as-algorithm.
eval_metrics: Evaluation uses 53 downstream base-model tasks via LLM-Foundry (no finetuning): QA, commonsense, math, textbook knowledge, open-ended generation. Three headline metrics: MMLU 5-shot; CORE centered accuracy (22 low-variance tasks including HellaSwag, ARC-E/C, BigBench, PIQA, AGIEval LSAT-AR, rescaled so 0=random, 1=perfect); and EXTENDED centered accuracy over all 53. Headline numbers: DCLM-BASELINE 7B on 2.6T tokens reaches 63.7% MMLU, 57.1 CORE, 45.4 EXTENDED -- +6.6pp MMLU over MAP-Neo with 40% less compute, comparable to Mistral-7B-v0.3 (63%) and Llama3-8B (66%) at 6.6x less compute than Llama3. At 7B-1x (280B tokens) MMLU is 50.8. Instruction tuning is measured by AlpacaEval2.0 LC win-rate (DCLM-IT 16.6 vs Gemma-Instruct 10.4, Mistral-v0.2 17.1, Llama3-Instruct 22.9) and 5-shot GSM8K chain-of-thought (2.1->52.5). Long-context is probed with multi-document QA (1/10/20/30-Docs).
key_results: DCLM-BASELINE 7B trained on 2.6T tokens reaches 63.7% MMLU 5-shot, +6.6pp over MAP-Neo with 40% less compute and within ~2-3pp of Llama3-8B at 6.6x less compute. fastText (OH-2.5+ELI5) quality filtering yields CORE 41.0 at 7B-1x vs 35.7 for Wikipedia positives; filtering-model choice swings 7B/280B MMLU from 35% to 44%. DCLM-IT instruction tuning reaches 16.6 AlpacaEval2.0 LC win-rate and lifts 5-shot GSM8K from 2.1 to 52.5.
evolution_note: Building on the DataComp vision benchmark and the RefinedWeb/CCNet/MinHash curation lineage (C4, The Pile, Dolma, FineWeb), DCLM systematizes data-centric LM research at 240T-token/7B scale as a reaction to closed-data models like Llama, Mistral, and Gemma. Its fastText OH-2.5+ELI5 recipe, cooldown model-soup, and multi-scale benchmark directly seed later open pretraining datasets such as Nemotron-CC, OLMo-2, and WebOrganizer and motivate data-centric post-training.
